Poligon ini harus mencakup seluruh wilayah yang menjadi fokus perhatian Anda (*region of interest*). GEM akan secara otomatis menentukan batas yang tepat dengan membuat *buffer* (penyangga) di sekeliling garis pantai yang berada di dalam poligon kasar tersebut. Tidak ada area di luar poligon kasar ini yang akan disertakan dalam analisis. Anda juga dapat menentukan area-area yang ingin dikecualikan dari analisis, atau Sub-Wilayah yang akan diperlakukan secara terpisah selama proses analisis. 

CRA mungkin memerlukan sedikit usaha untuk disusun bagi wilayah Anda. CRA ini harus berupa *shapefile* yang memuat petak-petak berbentuk persegi (sejajar dengan piksel) berukuran 70-85 meter di setiap sisinya, yang berisi contoh-contoh dari berbagai area klasifikasi Anda (Mangrove, Bukan Mangrove, Perairan, dll.). Selain itu, harus terdapat satu atribut yang mencantumkan nama kelas untuk setiap petak, serta satu atribut numerik lainnya yang memberikan angka representatif bagi kelas tersebut pada setiap petak.

Do you have Classification Reference Area (CRA) shapefiles to upload (or uploaded already)? Yes, I already have CRA shapefile(s). No, and I'd like to create my CRAs using this App. It is time to import or create Classification Reference Areas (CRAs)!

These are polygons within which are a small number of pixels that represent a land cover class (Closed Canopy Mangrove, Open Canopy Mangrove, Terrestrial Forest, Exposed Water etc.).

These polygons are then uploaded to Google Earth Engine and used to train a classifier that can then classify all the pixels in the imagery from your AOI. It typically requires 20-30 or more example CRAs per class to get good results from the classifier, although this app makes currently sets no hard requirement.

Even CRA is typically a 3x3 square containing 9 pixels from your imagery. This means for Sentinel-2, the square is approximately 30x30m, and for Landsat 90x90. On the next few screens you will be asked to import CRAs or reuse pre-existing CRAs you have imported in the past. On the next screen you will be able to create CRAs by panning and zooming a map that has both satellite imagery and false color composite layers.

In the center of the screen will be a polygon of an appropriate size, although it may be quite small when you zoom out.

Position this polygon over an area representing Mangrove (Closed/Open), Terrestrial Forest, Other Vegetation, Freshwater Vegetation, Barren Exposed land or Residual Water. Tap the plus button in the lower right to select the area inside the polygon as one of your CRAs and you will be asked to choose the land cover class.

When you have finished choosing CRAs, you can select the checkmark button in the lower right to submit these CRAs and move on to the classification.

You can change the shape of the polygon in the center of the screen by tapping the polygon button in the lower right. modify the shape of the central polygon for capturing CRAs finished creating CRAs capture the current area under the central polygon as a CRA Using %s polygon.
